comments.text: China feels like another world where ancient history meets breathtaking nature.

comments.author: @User-1s8u6g4wiq2g
comments.text: I know we are not supposed to think this place is gorgeous, but it is absolutely stunning. If our countries could just stop the wars what an incredible journey we could all potentially have by tourism in cultures unlike our own … pretty magnificent scenery there for certain. This has to be one of the most beautiful places on earth.  Praying for peace, lovely. We should never ever undo creation of such a wonderous places.  Every culture should be able to celebrate their own, and marvel at surrounding ones, not take them over. But, to def travel and see such destinations  I’ve seen lots of American expats there and can understand why. Thank you for letting them explore your beautiful country.

comments.author: @jacquelinewalters9986
comments.text: I would LOVE to visit China. It would take a lifetime to explore with all its amazing  and breathtaking sites and I am impressed with this culture's depth of knowledge and history on the positive side. They are supreme in many senses of the word and masters at what they set out to achieve.
